release.name: Ento-Linguistics v1.1.0 — Inferential Statistics, Real Ambiguity Scores, Token-Driven Manuscript
release.body:
Version 1.1.0 (2026-09-15)

Zenodo concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19574118

## Methods & statistics
- Root-caused and fixed the `ambiguity_score = 0.0` defect: a key-name mismatch meant every domain reported a fabricated zero; per-term semantic ambiguity now flows through with exclusions counted, never folded-in zeros.
- `cohens_d` (Hedges-corrected), documented Welch `t_test` (`equal_var` parameter), and `DomainAnalyzer.iter_domain_term_entropies` as the single per-term entropy implementation.

## Inferential statistics stage (new)
- `src/pipeline/statistics_pipeline.py`: per-domain descriptives, all 15 pairwise Welch t-tests with Benjamini–Hochberg correction and Cohen's d, one-way ANOVA with explicit η²; degenerate groups are skipped and recorded, never fabricated.
- Writes `output/data/statistical_analysis.json` and the new registered figure `statistical_analysis.png` (`fig:statistical_analysis`).
- Wired into `scripts/02_generate_figures.py` as a pipeline stage.

## Visualization
- `plot_statistical_analysis`: entropy descriptives ± SD, BH-significant Cohen's d diverging bars (colorblind-safe), ANOVA summary panel; 16pt floor, deterministic, Agg-safe.

## Manuscript
- S02 inferential tables are fully token-driven (`ANOVA_*`, `PAIRWISE_*`, `CORRECTION_METHOD`) and resolve at PDF render time from measured data — the full-corpus ANOVA is now honestly non-significant: F(5, 61) = 1.673, p = 0.155, η² = 0.121.
- Fabricated CI table removed; fabricated significance claims removed.
- Canonical manuscript markdown keeps `{{TOKEN}}` placeholders permanently; the fill stage is now a non-destructive dry-run (237 placeholders resolve).

## Pipeline & tooling
- Thin-orchestrator cutover completed for all scripts; logic lives in `src/pipeline`.
- All 46 test `subprocess.run` sites bounded by fail-on-timeout wrappers; missing-dependency skip verdict memoized.
- Branch coverage 93.42% (floor 90%); ruff clean; 1453 passed / 8 documented skips.

## Assets
The built manuscript PDF is `output/pdf/ento_linguistics_combined.pdf` in the tagged tree.
